# Archive Policy

## Purpose

The archive system provides a centralized, organized, and reliable repository for storing files and records that are no longer in active use but must be preserved for historical, legal, compliance, or reference purposes. The goals of the archive are to:

- Reduce clutter in active workspaces
- Preserve important records in a predictable, searchable structure
- Ensure long-term accessibility of historical information
- Support audit, compliance, and legal discovery requirements

## Retention Rules

Files placed in the archive are retained according to the following rules:

| Category | Retention Period |
|---|---|
| Financial records (invoices, receipts, tax documents) | 7 years |
| Legal contracts and agreements | 10 years (or duration of contract + 5 years, whichever is longer) |
| Project documentation and deliverables | 5 years after project closure |
| Internal communications and meeting notes | 3 years |
| HR records | Per applicable employment law (typically 7 years) |
| General business correspondence | 3 years |

- Files **must not** be modified once archived. Treat the archive as read-only.
- Files that have exceeded their retention period are eligible for secure deletion during the annual archive review (every January).
- If a file is subject to a legal hold, it must not be deleted regardless of retention period.

The archive is organized by **calendar year** corresponding to the year the file was created or the year the related activity concluded.

```
archive/

├── 2022/               ← files from calendar year 2022
├── 2023/               ← files from calendar year 2023
└── 2024/               ← files from calendar year 2024
```
